tasks.sql:
WITH rpt_products AS (
SELECT src.id, src.name, src.sku, src.billing_type, src.is_active, src.created_at FROM (
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.sku,
  p.billing_type,
  (p.status = 'active') AS is_active,
  p.created_at
FROM inventory.products p
WHERE p.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT id, name, sku, billing_type, is_active, created_at FROM rpt_products AS products WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY name LIMIT 50
